text_block_list.text: Our fulfilling training camp with Taiki Shuttle came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's sad that today
is the day we say goodbye to this place..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: However, very very strong! Thanks to the training camp, I've gotten so much stronger!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is,
I will NOT lose at a pillow fight!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Of course, my running was perfect too♪
I was able to step up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely become Umamusume of the Year, for suuure!!
